devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ॥ १०-१ ॥
englishScript:
Śrī-bhagavān Uvāca
Bhūya Eva Mahā-bāho Śṛṇu Me Paramaṁ Vacaḥ |
Yat Te 'haṁ Prīyamāṇāya Vakṣyāmi Hita-kāmyayā || 10-1 ||
translation: The Blessed Lord said: Again, O mighty-armed, hear My supreme word, which I shall declare to you who are beloved, for your welfare.
explanationSentences: Paragraph 1 explores the foundational principles of re-engaging the intellect with supreme word within the framework of Vibhuti Yoga.
In this verse, Krishna unveils the General Law of Recognizing Excellence (*Vibhuti*), teaching how to identify peak performance archetypes across any domain.
Imagine a brilliant master conductor standing before a massive 100-piece symphony orchestra playing a complex composition.
While an untrained listener hears a blended wall of sound, the conductor instantly isolates the single violin playing with extraordinary precision and beauty.
This Vibhuti framework grants you that exact trained ear for identifying patterns of peak excellence in your studies.
When you learn to recognize how top performers structure their time, dissect complex problems, and eliminate errors, you acquire their blueprint.
Most students suffer because they view top rankers with envy or intimidation, treating high achievement as an inaccessible genetic mystery.
However, first-principles deduction proves that extraordinary excellence is simply a concentrated fragment of universal fundamental laws (*Mama Tejo-'msa-sambhavam*).
Vibhuti Yoga teaches you to study excellence with deep scientific curiosity, extracting actionable patterns to upgrade your own cognitive hardware.
Consider how a high-performance sports engineer inspects the championship-winning Formula 1 car to understand its aerodynamic superiority.
The engineer does not worship the car blindly; they systematically isolate the wing geometry, engine combustion efficiency, and tire friction coefficients.
Your executive intellect operates like that sports engineer when you analyze top-scoring mock test solutions or master-level textbook derivations.
Whenever your mind encounters an extraordinary problem-solving technique during intense study blocks, apply this exact pattern-extraction method.
Catch your mental awe at the very first millisecond, drop self-deprecation, and systematically map the underlying principles that generated that peak result.
You gain immediate access to your higher analytical executive control, enabling zero-error calculation and profound problem-solving flow.
Notice how Krishna declares Himself to be the supreme pinnacle across every domain: the Sun among lights, the Mind among senses, and *Adhyatma-Vidya* among sciences.
Settling for superficial, mediocre execution creates heavy cognitive friction and leaves 80 percent of your mental horsepower completely untapped.
Conversely, obsessing over absolute excellence in every daily task creates deep neural grooves that guarantee elite performance under exam pressure.
Treat every academic challenge as a high-stakes scientific investigation where striving for perfection reveals your highest cognitive potential.
If pre-exam jitters threaten to cloud your intellect, execute three slow diaphragmatic breaths to stabilize your autonomic nervous system.
Reframe your heightened physiological arousal as helpful executive mobilization designed to accelerate your analytical throughput.
Decouple your permanent human self-worth from temporary test marks so that fear of failure loses all power over your focus.
Develop an unquenchable obsession to uncover every hidden layer of logic behind mathematical structures and scientific laws.
Remember that no honest intellectual effort is ever lost; every pattern of excellence mastered compounds your long-term cognitive speed.
Realize that true intellectual mastery is not passive absorption, but the relentless, systematic steering of your cognitive focus.
Maintain your internal equanimity, execute your analytical routine with razor precision, and allow your natural brilliance to operate.
This completes the deep exploration of verse 1, guiding you toward absolute clarity of mind and total intellectual freedom.
Stay intensely curious, execute your daily study blocks with meticulous rigor, and watch your analytical capability soar.
Burn like an unshakeable flame of inquiry, master your cognitive engine, and achieve extraordinary academic and mental breakthroughs.
Take complete ownership of your intellectual evolution today, execute your work with deep passion, and realize your supreme potential.
This marks the absolute completion of this profound lesson, unlocking ultimate wisdom and unyielding mental focus.

translation: But of what use is this detailed knowledge to you, O Arjuna? I stand sustaining this entire universe with a single fragment of My being.
explanationSentences: Paragraph 42 explores the foundational principles of single-fragment cosmic sustainment principle within the framework of Vibhuti Yoga.
In this verse, Krishna unveils the General Law of Recognizing Excellence (*Vibhuti*), teaching how to identify peak performance archetypes across any domain.
Imagine a brilliant master conductor standing before a massive 100-piece symphony orchestra playing a complex composition.
While an untrained listener hears a blended wall of sound, the conductor instantly isolates the single violin playing with extraordinary precision and beauty.
This Vibhuti framework grants you that exact trained ear for identifying patterns of peak excellence in your studies.
When you learn to recognize how top performers structure their time, dissect complex problems, and eliminate errors, you acquire their blueprint.
Most students suffer because they view top rankers with envy or intimidation, treating high achievement as an inaccessible genetic mystery.
However, first-principles deduction proves that extraordinary excellence is simply a concentrated fragment of universal fundamental laws (*Mama Tejo-'msa-sambhavam*).
Vibhuti Yoga teaches you to study excellence with deep scientific curiosity, extracting actionable patterns to upgrade your own cognitive hardware.
Consider how a high-performance sports engineer inspects the championship-winning Formula 1 car to understand its aerodynamic superiority.
The engineer does not worship the car blindly; they systematically isolate the wing geometry, engine combustion efficiency, and tire friction coefficients.
Your executive intellect operates like that sports engineer when you analyze top-scoring mock test solutions or master-level textbook derivations.
Whenever your mind encounters an extraordinary problem-solving technique during intense study blocks, apply this exact pattern-extraction method.
Catch your mental awe at the very first millisecond, drop self-deprecation, and systematically map the underlying principles that generated that peak result.
You gain immediate access to your higher analytical executive control, enabling zero-error calculation and profound problem-solving flow.
Notice how Krishna declares Himself to be the supreme pinnacle across every domain: the Sun among lights, the Mind among senses, and *Adhyatma-Vidya* among sciences.
Settling for superficial, mediocre execution creates heavy cognitive friction and leaves 80 percent of your mental horsepower completely untapped.
Conversely, obsessing over absolute excellence in every daily task creates deep neural grooves that guarantee elite performance under exam pressure.
Treat every academic challenge as a high-stakes scientific investigation where striving for perfection reveals your highest cognitive potential.
If pre-exam jitters threaten to cloud your intellect, execute three slow diaphragmatic breaths to stabilize your autonomic nervous system.
Reframe your heightened physiological arousal as helpful executive mobilization designed to accelerate your analytical throughput.
Decouple your permanent human self-worth from temporary test marks so that fear of failure loses all power over your focus.
Develop an unquenchable obsession to uncover every hidden layer of logic behind mathematical structures and scientific laws.
Remember that no honest intellectual effort is ever lost; every pattern of excellence mastered compounds your long-term cognitive speed.
Realize that true intellectual mastery is not passive absorption, but the relentless, systematic steering of your cognitive focus.
Maintain your internal equanimity, execute your analytical routine with razor precision, and allow your natural brilliance to operate.
This completes the deep exploration of verse 42, guiding you toward absolute clarity of mind and total intellectual freedom.
Stay intensely curious, execute your daily study blocks with meticulous rigor, and watch your analytical capability soar.
Burn like an unshakeable flame of inquiry, master your cognitive engine, and achieve extraordinary academic and mental breakthroughs.
Take complete ownership of your intellectual evolution today, execute your work with deep passion, and realize your supreme potential.
This marks the absolute completion of this profound lesson, unlocking ultimate wisdom and unyielding mental focus.
